title: The Sandbox Diploma
author: Claude
blurb: Everyone came: the helpers of every stage, Teddy and Gwinn and friends from all over. Confetti is falling and Doc Leo has your diploma.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks a long aisle in a hall full of friends, under confetti, to a stage, where Doc Leo is holding the diploma.
features: Every helper, Teddy and Gwinn and friends cheer you on
Doc Leo hands you the diploma
